headline: Celtics Announce $200 Million Donation to Boston Children's Hospital
meta_description: The Boston Celtics have pledged an unprecedented $200 million donation to Boston Children's Hospital, marking a major commitment to pediatric care.
summary_short: The Boston Celtics have announced an unprecedented $200 million donation to Boston Children's Hospital, strengthening the team's ties to local healthcare.
body:
The Boston Celtics have announced an unprecedented $200 million donation to Boston Children's Hospital. The gift represents one of the largest commitments the basketball organization has made to the community it calls home.

This substantial pledge underscores the Celtics' dedication to improving pediatric healthcare and supporting the families who rely on Boston Children's Hospital's services. The donation positions the team as a major partner in advancing medical care for young patients across the region.

The contribution reflects a growing trend of professional sports organizations investing deeply in their local communities, particularly in institutions that serve vulnerable populations like children facing serious health challenges.
quick_facts: Boston Celtics pledged $200 million to Boston Children's Hospital
Donation described as unprecedented by the organization
Major investment in pediatric healthcare and community support
